title: MESA — Decision Landscape
role: Full-stack engineering of the local harness
status: Local development prototype (private, v0.2.0). Not production.
summary: I built a local workspace that takes a complex operational rehearsal from a versioned scenario graph through a facilitated session to a publication that stays immutable until evidence is inspected. Generated text is a proposal, not an approval.
problem: Rehearsals, findings, and after-action reports usually split across documents. Scores appear where nobody looked, and published conclusions get edited in place.
solution: One versioned definition feeds a pinned exercise. Commands return receipts. Findings need inspected citations. Reports publish an exact digest. AI output is accepted or rejected against that digest.
highlights: 70-screen route registry with legacy URL aliases
Scenario graph projected from the definition, not a second model
Command lifecycle where accepted is not executed
Not-observed stays non-numeric and cannot be approved as a score
Scope projection strips facilitator-only content from participant views
Reviewed AI proposals with version and digest checks
MESA design tokens, accessible verification icons, and explicit empty states
limitations: Local harness only. Persona switching is not authentication.
Workflow state is one JSON document per organization.
React hosts the shell; most screens are still HTML strings.
Publication digests are a non-cryptographic hash, not signatures.
No public demo, no production deploy, no measured users.
Historical test notes disagree (36, 69, 70). Re-run before citing a count.
GLASSHOUSE facilitator content is compiled into the client bundle.
nextSteps: Capture the two portfolio videos with fixture chrome hidden
Confirm public clearance for MESA, STRATA, and GLASSHOUSE
Replace unused duplicate view renderers as React screens land
Move facilitator-only content server-side before any non-local use
Replace the FNV digest before claiming external trust
